evidence: The tier-7 build uses 6 HD and has neither the level-9 spell resistance nor the level-9 greater powers. The class gives a fear effect on a hit but its table gives no separate unlock. The 2000 Monster Manual supplies the claw as the trigger for improved grab, and the 3.0 general rule supplies the smaller-target limit. For spell DCs, use the sorcerer spell level when available, otherwise use the original cleric or druid spell level. The barbs deal damage during impale.
